contract.purpose: Persist attachment metadata in session transcripts without embedding transient binary-heavy fields.
contract.scope: Loop transcript writes, session transcript reads, desktop replay loading, and attachment persistence sanitization.

invariants.invariant-1: Session JSONL retains attachment identity and file metadata needed for replay and UI chips.
invariants.invariant-2: Transient `dataUrl` fields and data-URL previews are stripped before persistence.
